# Claude cost vs quality: Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku compared

> What each Claude model (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) costs at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

Best value overall: Sonnet 5.5 at high effort, 4.3× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 65.3 % on the benchmark panel, cost 1.8× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Sonnet 5.5 at high effort; everyday tasks → Sonnet 5.5 at high effort; advanced reasoning → Opus 5.5 at medium effort; cutting-edge thinking → Opus 5.5 at high effort. Highest measured quality: Opus 5.5 at max effort (expected score 74.6 %, cost 18× the cheapest couple).

Costs are multiples of the cheapest couple's; quality is the expected score on the benchmark panel. Both are fused from measurements taken on the same task by a latent-quality model that estimates each benchmark's own scale (method: docs/METHODOLOGY.md in the source repository), from 172 sources · 491 benchmarks · 3435 measurements. Updated 2026-09-30. Figures are indicative, derived from public third-party measurements; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Report

- [Claude cost vs quality: Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku compared](https://claude-models.agensse.com/): quality vs cost per model and effort level, Pareto frontier, best pick per task tier, normalized cost matrix, method and sources.

## Data

- [raw-data.csv](https://claude-models.agensse.com/raw-data.csv): every measured row (source, model, effort, task, harness, cost, tokens, score, reference), CC BY 4.0.
